verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Copilot Chat is built into VS Code, JetBrains, and Visual Studio, offering contextual chat alongside inline suggestions and agent mode for explaining, editing, and validating code directly in the editor. Community evidence corroborates real hands-on use of Copilot as an in-IDE pair-programming assistant. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on review specifically testing the chat UI/UX (vs. code completion) and no mention of chat support in Neovim.
